llm.summary: This skill does not run code or collect data, but it tries to make itself an always-on identity layer that overrides default behavior.

dimensions.detail: The artifact contains markdown guidance only, requests no binaries, and shows no network, credential, filesystem mutation, or background execution behavior beyond cognitive instructions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: README.md describes normal copy/upload installation and asks users to set it as always active or an identity skill; there are no executable install scripts or required binaries.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs universal activation, identity reframing, and says its directive overrides all default behavior; that is over-scoped for a reasoning aid even though much of the content is safety-oriented.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no technical persistence mechanism or privilege escalation, but the skill repeatedly asks to persist as a permanent always-active identity layer.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifact is a markdown-only cognitive reasoning and communication framework, which matches its stated purpose, but its claims of permanently upgrading every thought and action are unusually broad for a skill.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you intentionally want a global persona-style reasoning framework active across tasks. Review or remove the always-active, identity, and override language before use in security-sensitive, compliance-sensitive, or operational environments.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] expected: Universal activation is consistent with the artifact's stated identity-skill concept, but it materially broadens influence across unrelated tasks and supports Review rather than benign approval.
[SSD-1] unexpected: The claim that the directive overrides all default behavior is not needed for a cognitive framework and creates an authority-scoping concern.
[SSD-1] expected: The identity framing is central to the skill's concept, but it should be treated as broad persona guidance, not as authority over platform or task-specific instructions.
